description: A borderless two-column row: the left cell wraps onto two closely-spaced lines while the right cell ('42') is a single line at the same row as the left cell's first line. Stage 1's block grouping (extract::group_blocks) now carries a horizontal-gutter guard alongside its vertical-gap test, so the right cell's single line stays a block of its own instead of merging into the left cell's block as a third line. layout::detect_borderless_table_regions then classifies the row as a Table purely from that gutter geometry (no ruling lines needed), and serialize::render_page falls back to ordering the row's own blocks left-to-right when graphics::table_grid_cells finds no ruling-line grid to reconstruct from.
